nearest_text_before.text: Если у вас есть хронические заболевания, например диабет, заболевания щитовидной железы или гипертония, то это нужно обсудить с профильным специалистом. Он подберет безопасное лечение, скорректирует лекарства и назначит нужные витамины.

nearest_text_after.text: Принимайте фолиевую кислоту и дополнительные витамины по назначению

image_reading: A smiling woman sits comfortably on a sofa, looking down at and holding an orange smartphone.
Her raised hand is poised over the phone screen; the relaxed home setting and her expression convey calm focus.
analysis.article_context: Body image for the section on necessary consultations and examinations. It supports the advice to prepare questions before an appointment, presenting calm, attentive planning on a phone.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Calmly preparing practical questions before a medical consultation is part of thoughtful pregnancy planning.
structured_intent.primary_action: The woman completes one deliberate tap on her smartphone.
structured_intent.terminal_state: Her finger has completed the tap and her hand rests naturally while the smartphone remains visible.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: She remains calm, positively focused, and engaged in preparation throughout.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, her index finger moves naturally from above the screen into one deliberate tap, with a small settling motion in her wrist afterward. Her relaxed smile and gaze stay focused on the phone throughout. Use a fixed camera so the phone and the completed tap remain readable in the final moments.
models.positive_prompt: The woman makes one calm, deliberate downward tap on the smartphone screen, then lets her hand settle while she keeps her warm focused smile; the phone remains clearly visible in her hands at the end. Fixed camera.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, let the woman’s hand travel steadily into a single intentional touch on the phone screen, then ease into a natural resting position rather than repeating the gesture. Keep the framing fixed and preserve her calm, purposeful attention until the final frame.
models.positive_prompt: She calmly completes one deliberate tap on her smartphone and settles her hand, maintaining a warm, focused smile as the phone stays visible in her hands. Fixed camera.

models.scene_plan: Across four seconds, show one compact, measured phone interaction: her hovering finger lowers to the screen and completes one tap, followed by a slight natural hand settle. Maintain her relaxed smile and attentive gaze; the fixed framing keeps the phone visible through the endpoint.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. The woman makes one gentle, deliberate tap on the smartphone screen, then her hand settles as she keeps a calm, focused smile; the phone is clearly visible in the final frame.
